author: SBMous
body:
So, I am making a Nebula map (DTM) and was wondering about a few things:

    1)  Does anyone think that a vertical map could work? One where you go up rather than forward.
    2)  Also, is there a way of stopping the breakage of certain blocks or an area?
    3)  Finally, If you think a vertical map could work, what is the best way of going up quickly in 1.7?
          I was thinking of slime blocks but they're 1.8.

Thanks!
   SBMous

title: Just a question

replies.author: Riskayyy
replies.body:
1) It's not recommended since one team would have an advantage over the other. (unbalanced)
2) Yes, it's possible to deny players from breaking/building blocks in an area (known as a region)
3) Remember, Avicus is both 1.7 and 1.8. Slime blocks wouldn't work with 1.7 clients. Instead, you could use YML features (You may want to ask someone for help with that :P)

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
1) sure they would work, but nobody tried to make such a map.
2) use the region modules. for more information click here.
3) use 1.7 blocks. Because if you use 1.8 blocks players that are using the 1.7 version can't see them.

replies.body:
Yup, you can select blocks to trigger particular events when players interact, leave, enter (...and more!) regions.
If you need assistance with the YML, contact any map developer! (not to mention the community is filled with helpful and willing users!)

replies.author: Sevoo
replies.body:
Tbh vertical maps would destroy the pvp aspect, since all you have to do is get on top and hit people off. You would never get a monument, even if you did the game would be more stalemate than the old Frosbite .-.

But I see you're trying to find something original, so keep searching, and I reccomend you get multiple opinions.

replies.author: SBMous
replies.body:
It would be Two Towers on either side of the map, leading to a lot of bridging and some cool tactical game-play.
There would be little tunneling and it would be a very difficult map. Probably a tourney map for the most part due to the difficulty.
The tower is currently 100 blocks tall and 40 x 40 at the base going to 20 x 20 at the top.
It will be modern styled, think Warface's HQ as my main inspiration.
Also, I'll call it "The Spires", don't worry :P
